feed.title: The Latest Damaged View of the Pier: newly hung
feed.subtitle: New views of Brighton West Pier as they are hung, and the question of the week. Human and machine work hang unlabelled; each page says who made it.

entry.title: Question of the week: Every time the sea takes another piece of the pier, people go and photograph wha…
entry.summary: Every time the sea takes another piece of the pier, people go and photograph what is left. If a machine makes the next thousand pictures of it, what is actually lost: the picture, or the reason for taking it?
